title: Statistical Inference on Gradient Flows
summary: Gradient-based algorithms are central to modern statistical estimation, yet their statistical analysis is often restricted to fixed-time behavior, such as convergence to a population target or fluctuations at a prescribed iteration. In many applications, however, uncertainty quantification is needed along the entire optimization path, especially when the stopping time is data-dependent or divergent.
